items.title: How diff op count scales with list size when deleting one middle item
items.description: This reproduces L3's exact measurement: deleting one item from the middle of a list, comparing unkeyed (position-based) diffing against keyed (identity-based) diffing. Unkeyed cost scales with how many items sit after the deleted one; keyed cost stays fixed at 1 no matter the list size.
items.compute: const half = Math.floor(params.listSize / 2); const unkeyedOps = params.listSize - half + 1; const keyedOps = 1; return { unkeyedOps, keyedOps };
